_comment: Stage mapping, section 8.2 of the brief. Configuration, not code, so a stage
name change can be corrected without a redeploy.
TWO SEPARATE FEEDS, and they do not agree. This matters.
byStageId  HubSpot deal stages, discovered 26 August 2026. Keyed on the
opaque stage id, never the label, because a label is a display
string any CRM user can rename.
byLabel    The stage names observed arriving at Meta as pixel events
(QUALIFIED, QualifiedLead, Quote Sent, Send Quote, CONVERTED).
NONE of these is a HubSpot deal stage label. HubSpot's labels
are the defaults: Qualified To Buy, Contract Sent, Closed Won.
So the Meta stage feed is NOT coming from HubSpot deal stages.
It comes from somewhere else, most likely Zoho or a mapping
inside the sync. Until that source is identified, the Meta
stage events cannot be reconciled against the CRM.
Anything unrecognised lands in unmapped and is surfaced on the data health
panel. A non zero unmapped count means a stage name has changed.

byStageId._comment: Contract Pipeline (148114589) and the default Sales Pipeline. Discovered 26 August 2026.

_ignoreComment: LEADS is not a stage. It is listed so it does not inflate the unmapped alarm, but it is excluded from every funnel count.

cumulative._comment: Quotes issued is deals at quote stage or beyond, and qualified likewise. A deal that reached won also counts as quoted and qualified.

deadReasons._comment: Panel 2 shows dead leads as a separate branch with a reason breakdown.
deadReasons.Unqualified: Did not meet credit or business criteria
deadReasons.BAD: Bad data or bad faith enquiry

stageLabels._comment: For display only. Never match on these.

observedStageDistribution._comment: All 49 deals, 26 August 2026. THIS IS THE PROBLEM. 47 of 49 deals sit in Prospect Inquiry, including deals with payment start dates and cleared deposits. Zero deals have ever reached Closed Won, while the customer database shows 24 active paying customers. The stage field is not maintained, so it cannot be used to count signed or won.
